title: Spicy Ancho Chicken Wrap
description: A flavorful and spicy wrap filled with grilled chicken, ancho peppers, and tangy vinegar.

ingredients.name: uzumaki vinegar
ingredients.notes: substitute with apple cider vinegar if needed

instructions: 2. In a small bowl, mix together ancho peppers, argentinian chimichurri sauce, and uzumaki vinegar.
3. Brush the mixture onto the chicken breasts and grill for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Warm the tortilla by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
5. Assemble the wrap by placing the grilled chicken onto the tortilla, followed by lettuce, tomatoes, and cheese (if using).
6. Drizzle with additional argentinian chimichurri sauce (if desired).
